test_title: PYST 57: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure from the given options would replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/657664291c041faae31172fd6ff59dad6f9932b263c3c2cd867139b42074cf80.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: The letter 'D' is shifting a place in a clockwise direction in the next images

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7535521620c51b09ed6b24092e9a523096c9fc08427bf6068789f4ea3513fe70.png] 

Step II: The number '2' is shifting a place in a clockwise direction in the next images

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c786eb63fdfa118ab70bbf0c1b009705c7448671db8788f39a8fdf66f1789a80.png] 

Step III: The letter 'A' is shifting a place in a clockwise direction in the next images

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e31cffe88a7e9262dedde3ee7dfb1072b4eeb5e9b66f1ff2e6efb0668fed187.png] 

Step IV: The character '★' is shifting a place in a clockwise direction in the next images

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1898950f3348aab4a6a7228924b5158dcb5a18268c2bdee5efd222b4dc5c3881.png] 

Step V: The character '→' is rotating at 45º anticlockwise direction in the next images

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85042f5bdf1c01920c31125a4658dfc1c5445c5a50a676f9aa06cecd7b56817c.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea15da32da7d88e58d02f253e57ab4e56e035f453c4b37cad8335e6064d163b2.png] 

So, 'Option 4' will replace the question mark.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
